name: Bharwa Karela
ingredients: Saunf, amchur, coriander and 1 tsp oil
steps: Scrape and slit karela; remove seeds.
Mix soy, chana dal and spices.
Cook covered with a little water; uncover to brown lightly.
note: Karela is not a substitute for diabetes medication.
